school: 晚清湘军统帅/理学经世派
historical_significance: 曾国藩（1811—1872），初名子城，字伯涵，号涤生，湖南湘乡人，晚清湘军创立者与统帅、理学家、洋务运动先驱。道光十八年（1838）中进士，入翰林院，官至两江总督、直隶总督、武英殿大学士，封一等毅勇侯，谥文正。咸丰三年（1853）以在籍侍郎身份办团练，创建湘军，以'结硬寨、打呆仗'的稳拙战法与太平军相持十余年，历经靖港、湖口惨败（两度投水自尽被救）、屡败屡战，终在同治三年（1864）攻克天京，平定太平天国；随即主动奏裁湘军二万五千人，自剪羽翼以释清廷之疑。他是理学的践行者，道光二十二年（1842）立'日课十二条'，以主敬、静坐、早起、读书不二、写日记等日日自省数十年；标举'尚拙'，以笨功夫破天下之巧；名书房为'求阙斋'，以'花未全开月未圆'为惜福保泰之道。同治元年（1862）创办安庆内军械所（中国第一家新式兵工厂），后与李鸿章共建江南制造总局、设翻译馆，同治十一年（1872）临终前领衔奏派幼童留美，被称为'中华创始之举，古来未有之事'。其幕府号称晚清人才渊薮，'广收、慎用、勤教、严绳'四法育人，幕僚后出任督抚者数十人。同治九年（1870）办理天津教案，为顾大局忍辱负重、攘垢忍尤，内疚神明而次年病逝于两江总督任上。
historical_significance_en: Zeng Guofan (1811-1872), originally named Zicheng, courtesy name Bohan, sobriquet Disheng, born in Xiangxiang, Hunan, was the founder and supreme commander of the Xiang Army, a Neo-Confucian statesman, and a pioneer of the Self-Strengthening Movement in the late Qing. A jinshi of 1838, he rose through the Hanlin Academy to Viceroy of Liangjiang and of Zhili, Grand Secretary of Wuying Hall, First-Class Marquis of Yiyong, with the posthumous title Wenzheng. In 1853, as a metropolitan official in mourning at home, he organized militia into the Xiang Army and fought the Taiping for over a decade with the deliberate, plodding strategy of 'building strong stockades and fighting dull battles.' After catastrophic defeats at Jinggang and Hukou (twice attempting suicide by water) he persevered—'repeatedly defeated, repeatedly fighting'—until taking Nanjing in 1864; he at once petitioned to disband 25,000 Xiang troops, trimming his own wings to allay court suspicion. A practicing Neo-Confucian, in 1842 he instituted the 'Twelve Daily Rules' (reverence, quiet sitting, early rising, reading one book through, diary-keeping) and examined himself daily for thirty years. He championed 'honoring clumsiness'—breaking the world's cleverness with plodding effort—named his study the 'Studio of Seeking Imperfection,' and held 'flowers not fully open, moon not fully round' as the way to preserve blessing. In 1862 he founded the Anqing Arsenal, China's first modern arms works; with Li Hongzhang he built the Jiangnan Arsenal and its translation bureau, and in 1872, weeks before his death, co-signed the memorial dispatching China's first government students to America. His magnificent yamen-staff school, run by the methods 'widely recruit, cautiously employ, diligently teach, strictly discipline,' produced dozens of governors and governors-general. Handling the Tianjin Massacre of 1870, he bore national obloquy for the sake of the state and died in 1872 at his Liangjiang post, conscience-stricken to the end.

cross_references.relation_type: 理学传承：关学躬行与湘乡日课
cross_references.description_zh: 张载以'为学先要变化气质'立教，主张功夫应在日用伦常中躬行践履；曾国藩将此理学习气落实为日课十二条与终身日记，每日以主敬、静坐、读书不二磨砺自己。张载是理学气本论的建构者，曾国藩是理学修养论最彻底的实践者，二人共同展示了儒学从'讲道理'到'做功夫'的路径。
cross_references.description_en: Zhang Zai taught that learning begins with transforming one's temperament and that effort must be practiced in everyday conduct; Zeng Guofan institutionalized this Neo-Confucian discipline as the Twelve Daily Rules and a lifelong diary, honing himself daily through reverence, quiet sitting, and single-book reading. Zhang was the architect of qi-based Neo-Confucian metaphysics; Zeng its most thorough practitioner of self-cultivation—together they show Confucianism's path from doctrine to discipline.

cross_references.relation_type: 思想存续：刊刻船山遗书的知音
cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之隐居石船山著书四十年，遗稿几近湮没；曾国藩兄弟于金陵刻书局系统刊刻《船山遗书》320卷，使船山之学大放于晚清，成为湖湘士人精神源头之一。王夫之以孤明之思总结明亡教训，曾国藩以经世之业接续其学，二者构成'埋首者'与'传灯者'的两端。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Fuzhi wrote in seclusion for forty years, his manuscripts nearly lost; Zeng Guofan and his brother systematically printed the 320-juan Complete Works of Wang Fuzhi at the Jinling publishing bureau, reviving Wang's thought as a spiritual wellspring of late-Qing Hunan literati. Wang distilled the lessons of the Ming collapse in lonely brilliance; Zeng carried his learning into statecraft—the hermit and the lamp-carrier.
